# The Reasoning Library

Canonical library: https://reasoning-library.vercel.app/

## Books
- Manipulation — The Fool and the Wise: https://manipulation-book.vercel.app/
  - Indexed sample: https://manipulation-book.vercel.app/sample
  - Method and source standards: https://manipulation-book.vercel.app/methodology
  - AI / HCI research route: https://manipulation-book.vercel.app/ai-human-behavior
  - Manipulation and AI safety: https://manipulation-book.vercel.app/ai-safety-manipulation
  - Human agency and AI interface design: https://manipulation-book.vercel.app/human-agency-hci
- The Structure of Life — The Structure of Reasoning: https://the-structure-of-life.vercel.app/
  - Indexed sample: https://the-structure-of-life.vercel.app/sample

## Library scope
Independent reference books by J. Nasr on human behavior, reasoning, hidden structure, reframing and cross-disciplinary problem analysis.

Both published books use USD 23.33 as the canonical current price. Public repository files contain reader-facing website material and public samples; paid full-content packages remain private.
